notes: The standard three-rung Dominion Op shape, identical to Op 01 and Op 02 (Altepa) already in the corpus: accept, cull, report. 'Dominion Sergeant' is one of the generic names that would otherwise mark every matching entity in the world, so every step carries the resolved zone -- Abyssea - Altepa, which needs the Abyssea-scoped zone rule, since a bare 'Altepa' would land on Western/Eastern Altepa Desert. The DAT writes the name with a '#' the wiki title omits, hence match_rule 'exact' rather than 'exact_verbatim'. The kill quota (5) is recorded on the mob but is not observable -- no packet counts kills -- so step 2 has no evidence and the ladder relies on the session latch between accepting and reporting. The trailing 'For more information, see Dominion Ops.' is a cross-reference, not a bullet and not a step. Fame 'aalt' is an Abyssea zone code, not one of the nine regions, so it gates nothing and only the raw is kept.

notes: Four bullets, three steps. Bullet 3 is not an action of yours: it is the outcome of bullet 2 plus a hard precondition, so it merges into step 2 and supplies that step's evidence -- the Holy candle key item, which the header also names as the Item Req. The precondition is the real judgement call here. The page says Rouliette only hands the candle over 'once you complete the quest Candle-making', but the header's Previous field is EMPTY, and gates.prev is deliberately left empty to match it: prereq evaluation runs before a quest is started, and you can start this one by speaking to Ilumida whether or not Candle-making is done. Gating on it would hide a marker a player is entitled to. Flagged instead so a human can decide. The sub-bullet about farming a Lanolin Cube from Battering Rams in La Theine Plateau or Rams in Lufaise Meadows, Abyssea - La Theine or Caedarva Mire is material for Candle-making, a DIFFERENT quest, and is not a step here. 'Temple of the Goddess' is not a zone -- it is the cathedral inside Upper Jeuno, it resolves to no zone id, and the page's own category is Upper Jeuno Quests -- so Rouliette's (H-9) is recorded as an Upper Jeuno grid. Step 3 holds the candle rather than trading it, since key items are handed over through dialogue. VERIFY (stage D): demoted to medium. The ladder is right and every step checks out, but the quest object asserts prev=[] against a walkthrough that states a hard prerequisite quest outright -- bullet 3, 'once you complete the quest Candle-making'. That is the 'ladder is right but a gate is unmodelled' case, and a player who has not done Candle-making will sit on step 2's marker with no way to advance and nothing telling them why. Nothing is added here; the confidence is lowered so a human decides whether Candle-making belongs in gates.prev.

steps.note: in the Temple of the Goddess, which is a building inside Upper Jeuno and not a zone of its own. She only hands the candle over once the quest Candle-making is complete -- see the quest note.

notes:
A marker GAIN at the start. The header writes the giver as a bare '???', which can never match a live entity, but bullet 1 names the thing you actually check: the Stone Monument at (C-7) in Riverne - Site #A01. That name resolves, so start moves to it and the header string is kept in start.raw. Same object, better handle.

What the page does NOT say is where the four Giant Scale go. The header's Item Reqs demands them and the walkthrough never mentions them once -- not a trade, not a hand-in, nowhere. Rather than guess a step for them (the second monument check at bullet 5 is the plausible place, but plausible is not read), no step carries them and the quest is demoted to medium. That is the honest loss: readiness will under-report, which is better than a step that reads ready on the wrong inventory.

Bullet 2 is the outcome of bullet 1, so they merge and the Ornamented scroll is step 1's evidence. Bullets 5 and 6 are two checks on the same monument with nothing observable between them and no way to tell them apart, so they are one rung with the order in the note -- the same call Divine Might's 'examine twice' makes. Bullet 7 is the opposite case: it is a kill AND a final check, so it splits into two. The quest ends on the monument; there is no NPC hand-in and none is invented. Note this Stone Monument is not one of An Explorer's Footsteps' seventeen -- only the zone separates them.
